notes.title: SCARLET NEXUS Story Demo Release: Special Interview with Miyajima Takumi
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40110298/fd30a8e4367c09b871da8ee6da163375d3b673f1.png[/img]

[b]Scenarist Miyajima Takumi[/b], known for her work on the [url=https://www.bandainamcoent.eu/tales-of]TALES OF[/url] series, has sat down and talked on her ambitions and inner stories of [url=https://www.bandainamcoent.eu/scarlet-nexus/scarlet-nexus]SCARLET NEXUS[/url]' world and scenario. 

[url=https://bnent.eu/SNX_Interview_Miyajima][h2]Learn More[/h2][/url]

notes.title: 『Free Update Ver.1.08』
notes.notes:
[b]SCARLET NEXUS[/b] newest free upgrade is available today, it brings a [b]new story mode difficulty: “Very Easy”[/b], aimed at players who want less challenge or want to focus on the intricate story of SCARLET NEXUS.

Teaming up with another JRPG; this upgrade also welcomes [b]new objects[/b] from BANDAI NAMCO’s critically acclaimed game [i]Tales of Arise[/i], players can now bring the adorable [b]Hootle[/b] and other elements with them on all their future adventures.

And for players who have yet to join the Other Suppression Force, [b]a new story demo is coming soon[/b] with the first few chapters of the game and the possibility to keep the save data after purchasing the game.

[previewyoutube=6yvEEfcjplk;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/775500/SCARLET_NEXUS/

notes.title: 『Patch Update Ver.1.07』
notes.notes:
[b]You Asked, And We Heard![/b]
In this free update, several [b]highly-requested elements from SCARLET NEXUS fans[/b] are added into the game.

[h3][b]The New Photo Mode[/b][/h3]
Play around with the whole-new [b]"Photo Mode"[/b] to capture the best moments in the game! [b]Multiple camera options are made available[/b], allowing you to take your favorite photos at the convenience of a button press, any time while [b]exploring the world of SCARLET NEXUS[/b].
You can capture and save photos not only [b]during gameplay[/b], but also at your favorite moments [b]during cutscenes[/b].

[h3][b]"Very Hard" Difficulty and New Challenges[/b][/h3]
For those who want [b]more challenging gameplay[/b], set the game's difficulty to the new [b]"Very Hard" mode[/b] and face-off enemies with [b]even more powerful attacks[/b].
On top of that, for those who are [b]in search of an ultimate challenge[/b], try out the new Challenge missions and [b]get extremely rare rewards[/b], only if you can…

[h3][b]Equipable Support Plug-ins[/b][/h3]
For players who feel like the game is [b]still too hard even in “Easy” difficulty[/b], and those who would like to [b]experience the story without all the effort with defeating strong enemies[/b], we have added [b]new plug-ins to support your journey in SCARLET NEXUS[/b]! Just update your game and obtain the plug-ins immediately [b]in Shop for free[/b]!

[h3][b]New Collaboration Item[/b][/h3]
In commemoration of the [b]release of the Chapter 1 Blu-Ray Disc Set[/b] in Japan for the [b]SCARLET NEUXS anime series[/b], the [b]designed package and discs are added[/b] into the game as a [b]new present[/b]!

notes.title: 『New Paid DLC Pack 2 and free update 1.05 Deployed!』
notes.notes:
The [b]“Bond Enhancement Pack 2”[/b] DLC brings [b]10 new bond episodes[/b] to the game unlocking the [b]super-state “Nexus Drive”[/b] to [b]upgrade SAS abilities[/b]. Each character’s SAS will gain [b]new effects the player will have to master[/b], adding complexity to the game’s combat, such as [b]attack ranges[/b] and [b]SAS gauge recovery or consumption speed[/b].

[previewyoutube=AtD9b0dFhrI;full][/previewyoutube]
Players can showcase their [b]newly acquired skills[/b] all over New Himuka wearing the [b]stylish collaboration with artist Daisuke Richard[/b], offering a new fresh [b]set of costumes and weapons[/b], the [b]“Youth Attire” set[/b].
In addition to the new DLC, a free upgrade brings a [b]new feature called “Vision Simulator”[/b] allowing the player to r[b]ematch bosses fought in the main story[/b] and challenge missions with an [b]adjustable difficulty level[/b]. Difficulty will include [b]“Beginner”[/b], [b]“Novice”[/b] and [b]“Master”[/b]. The highest difficulty, “Master”, will provide a [b]more challenging and engaging experience[/b] to test the players skills after completing the main story.

[b]4 new Others variations[/b] are added to the game, each with a [b]unique added traits[/b] the players will have to [b]understand, counter and defeat[/b]. The shop will welcome [b]new challenges[/b], [b]costumes[/b], and [b]items[/b] via the free upgrade.

[h3][b]The Other Suppression Force needs you![/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1590566/SCARLET_NEXUS_Bond_Enhancement_Pack_2/

notes.title: 『Free Update Ver.1.04』
notes.notes:
[h3][b]『Updating OSF Calendar』[/b][/h3]

🔻 DLC name: [b]Bond Enhancement Pack 1 [/b]
Available: [b]November 17[/b]

The [b]Bond Enhancement Pack 1[/b] will contain [b]new costumes[/b] with original designs by [b]Yusuke Kozaki[/b], [b]new weapon sets[/b] and [b]new bond episodes[/b].

🔻 [b]Free Update Ver.1.04 is now available![/b]
We're pleased to announce the release of [b]Free Update Ver.1.04[/b], which adds [b]new "Challenges"[/b], [b]new store lineup of exchangable plug-ins[/b] and [b]new brain talk messages[/b].

The new "Challenges" include rewards such as [b]new attachments[/b], [b]new outfit variations[/b], and the awaited [b]"Weapon Skin" feature[/b] that enables you to change only the appearance of your weapons.
A [b]new lineup of exchangable plug-ins[/b] will also be added to the "Exchange" section of the store. These include plug-ins that activate [b]special SAS attacks[/b] (Assault Vision and Brain Drive) at preferred timing, as well as powerful plug-ins that assist health recovery etc.!

Also, in case you haven’t, do not forget to claim for [b]5 sets of weapons[/b] for the protagonists and an equipable cosmetic set!
*Only players who have not received such bonuses in the past will be eligible.

[b]Please check out and apply the update to continue enjoying Scarlet Nexus.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/775500/SCARLET_NEXUS/

notes.title: Accessing… 📁 『Upcoming Paid DLC Pack 1 & Free Update Ver.1.04』
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Upcoming New Paid DLC Pack "Bond Enhancement Pack 1"[/b][/h3]
The new bond level "EX" will be added to the bond system and players will be able to further enhance their bonds with their allies!

Enjoy the [b]10 new bond episodes[/b], 5 for each Yuito's and Kasane's story. Different from the base game, the new episodes will depict bonds between allies. [b]Discover new sides and experience the deepened bonds between allies and the protagonists.[/b]
Gifting new presents to liven up your hideout, enhance bonds, get photos and also matched attachments from your friends as well!
Leveling up to bond level "EX" will unlock [b]"Crush Vision"[/b], a new move that is extremely useful in battles!

Also, a new additional costume set, [b]“Fairy Tale Attire”[/b] will be made available. [b]Created by character designer and illustrator Yusuke Kozaki[/b], the costume set's design is based on the motif of fairy tales.
A weapon set which is designed based on the "Fairy Tale Attire" will also be available.

[previewyoutube=PCVhApnZ7xY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Upcoming Free Update Ver.1.04[/b][/h3]
The free update patch Ver.1.04 has also been announced!
Players will be able to continue enjoying the world of SCARLET NEXUS by getting various rewards through the new "Challenges", new plugins through shop exchange and also new brain talk messages that are related to the new contents added.
Rewards for "Challenges" include not only attachments and costume variations, but also "Weapon Skins" where you can change only the appearence of your equipped weapon to what you already possess.
New plugins include the ones that increase the activation probability of Assault Vision and Combo Vision, control over activation timing of Brain Drive, and more!

[b]These new contents will be coming soon, so please stay tuned![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/775500/SCARLET_NEXUS/

notes.title: 『Patch Update Ver.1.03』
notes.notes:
[b]Scarlet Nexus Ver1.03 has been released[/b], and the game has become more fun and playable with new gameplay options (camera, lock-on settings, animation toggles) and tweaks in this update!

[previewyoutube=WWRHKespmQw;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] Added new gameplay options
       - Camera position and tracking speed option
       - Enemy lock-on aim assist (Left stick control ON/OFF) option
       - Enemy lock-on camera speed option
       - Text size (brain talk messages / system log) adjustment option
       - SAS Activation Animation toggle option
[*] Smoother and quicker protagonists’ start movements outside battles
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]
[b]Please apply the latest update (1.03) and enjoy playing Scarlet Nexus.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/775500/SCARLET_NEXUS/

notes.title: 『Patch Update Announcement』
notes.notes:
A patch update for SCARLET NEXUS Steam version has been released fixing the following bugs:

- Unable to leave "Shop" with keyboard and mouse controls after receiving DLCs
- Character shadows don't show up when playing the game in certain languages

We apologize for any inconvenience caused and thank you for your continuous support.

notes.title: 『Patch Note Announcement』
notes.notes:
Dear Scarlet Nexus players,

Some of you have experienced problems while playing the game.
We identified the problem and this patch fixes the crash affecting players with non-alphanumeric characters in their Windows username.
We apologize for the inconvenience caused, thank you for your continuous support.
